rebrew.schema.json is a verbatim copy of contracts/dispatch/rebrew.schema.json
from the relumea backend (ai.relumea.app.backend-go), copied at commit
31b68b06aa80bb673d28184f8cde78642307aacc. The file last changed there in that
commit. The backend generates it with `go run ./cmd/surface-tracker`; replace
this copy when the contract changes, never edit it here. tests/test_ops.py
validates every op request and reply against it.
